what: The bottom edge of the Hero photo panel starts folded up on top and, after 2s, opens by lowering over 1.2s cubic-bezier(.67,.27,.39,.99) along an asymmetric hill curve (from the bottom-right corner it drops leftward to 63% height, then rises again to 83% at the left edge, a 33-point polygon). The background under the panel looks like it rises as a hill. With session given, from the second visit in the same tab it stays open

options.delay: Delay (sec), default 2 — reduce when attaching after a loader
options.to: Open bottom-edge points — from bottom right (100,100) leftward as x,y x,y … (%), default hill of 1366 and up in the original (33 points)
options.from: Folded start points (same count as to), x of the default to with y 0. In the original hill, the three leftmost points fold separately, so a wedge forms at the left edge while it opens
options.session: sessionStorage key — if given, it starts already open from the second visit in the same tab (original sessionLoad)
options.fx:done: Fires from the panel once fully open (or when it is already open)

note: Curve points are the original hero coordinates as they are. The original on phones (767px and below) is a gentler hill of 80 points — to/from are given separately for that screen (phone block of the original index.css)

from.where: index.html·index.css .hm-kv__inner (Hero photo curtain) — original index.css .kv-inner transition clip-path 1.2s cubic-bezier(.67,.27,.39,.99) 2s, polygon of .kv.loadding/.kv.active (36 points, phone 80 points) · index.js loadPage: loadding only on the first visit, active (opens immediately) on return visits
